evidence.evidence_text: We introduce TokMem, a procedural memory framework that compiles each reusable task procedure into a single trainable memory token.
We evaluate TokMem on two settings: atomic recall over 1,000 Super-Natural Instructions tasks and compositional recall on multi-step function-calling.
